training.batching: One full batch of all observed trace steps per epoch, including repeated edges, identical for both models
training.initialization: From scratch per seed/map/budget; same model initialization across nested budgets; no pretrained checkpoints
training.selection: Fixed final epoch; no validation/heldout/unseen/formal metric selection

config.representation: Identical float32 [4,6,6] wall/danger/goal/agent tensors built only from known S and L; identical action indices. Internal encoders differ by architecture.

mlp.definition: Flatten state tensor, concatenate learned action embedding, Linear(152,64), GELU, Linear(64,|S|); successor cross-entropy

jepa.decoder: Unchanged float32 torch.cdist Top-1 over all known valid state EMA embeddings; no topology filter or oracle repair

evaluation.transition_domain: All known S x A, including unreachable states; each (s,a) counted once
evaluation.heldout: Independent seeded stream; disjoint from all 16 training-pool trajectories, unique within heldout; fixed across budgets and models
evaluation.observed_edge_abstention: Unseen pairs are undefined and counted as incorrect (0% recall), not as neural predictions
evaluation.observed_edge_formal: Existing evaluation-only observed_self_loop_completion; no structural claims about raw partial R_G
evaluation.primary: Observed/unseen transition generalization and existing simulation/bisimulation with both action semantics
evaluation.diagnostics: Existing six CTL and six universal-path nuXmv LTL formulas at initial and all states; no fairness constraints
evaluation.additional_split: Reachable unseen and unreachable unseen state-action pairs reported separately
evaluation.aggregation: Macro case mean plus pooled correct/total and per-seed/per-family statistics

definitions.simulation_real_to_learned: Every real initial has a learned initial in the greatest forward simulation.
definitions.simulation_learned_to_real: Every learned initial has a real initial in the greatest reverse simulation.
definitions.initial_bisimulation: The greatest bisimulation covers both designated initial sets; for singletons, (i_real, i_learned) belongs to it. This is not mutual simulation.
definitions.identity_bisimulation: Shared state space only: forall s in S, (s,s) belongs to the greatest bisimulation, including unreachable states. Otherwise null (not applicable).
definitions.identity_simulation: The same diagonal-membership test on the indicated greatest simulation.
definitions.strict_identity: The diagonal alone is a relation: labels match and edges are included (simulation) or equal (bisimulation), with actions retained only when requested.
definitions.action_insensitive: Ignore action labels and duplicate targets, matching existing CTL/Kripke semantics.
definitions.action_sensitive: Match every challenged transition with an edge carrying the same action.
definitions.global: Global means the identity metric over all shared states, not just initials.
definitions.diagnostics: Top-1 and the fixed six CTL/LTL formulas are additional diagnostics. Finite-suite agreement is not a bisimulation certificate. Missing LTL is null.
